new_results.statement: In the final exact-rank3 mixed branch, if a light-bank longitudinal Schur variance rho_a>=eps, then ||p_Q||_inf <=3e[kappa^2 sqrt(c eps)]^(-1/3), kappa=7/800, c>3/10; continuity holds in this branch. At eps=.01 the bound is <505.697.

In the same branch, if |u^T Lambda u|>=delta, then ||p_Q||_inf <=182.0361225385 delta^(-1/4); at delta=.01 the bound is <575.649. Essential boundedness is proved; continuity is not asserted by this splice.
For independent 2D bank densities capped by M_1,M_2 and invertible 2x2 cross matrix S with arbitrary quadratic-affine self terms, H_{1/2}<=4sqrt(2)(M_1M_2)^(1/4)|det S|^(-1/4).

next_obligation.statement: Under simultaneous near-null heavy Rayleigh and near-planarity of both light banks, exploit ||Lambda u||>=1 and the two transverse elliptic product banks to obtain a grouped product-preserving density payment without conditioning on the full spectral complement or selecting one tiny physical minor.
